title: 摩擦力大比拼

goals: 感知摩擦力与表面粗糙度的关系

lab.code:
# 摩擦力大比拼探索台
surface = 1   # 1=冰面 2=木地板 3=毛毯
v0 = 20       # 初速度

hide()
d = v0 * 7 / surface
y = 50 - (surface - 1) * 55
pen_color("blue")
pen_down()
go_to(-190, y - 30)
go_to(190, y - 30)
pen_up()
col = "blue"
if surface == 1:
    col = "blue"
if surface == 2:
    col = "green"
if surface == 3:
    col = "red"
pen_color(col)
pen_down()
go_to(-180, y)
go_to(-180 + d, y)
pen_up()
write("🚗", -190, y, "red", 16)
sname = "冰面（摩擦小）"
if surface == 2:
    sname = "木地板（摩擦中）"
if surface == 3:
    sname = "毛毯（摩擦大）"
write(sname + "：滑 " + d + " 格", -190, 140, "red", 12)
write("初速度 " + v0, -190, 112, "blue", 11)
